title: BGP: upstream route leak trips max-prefix on pe-01 while leaf5 sessions flap

configs.config_text:
hostname pe-01
!
router bgp 65000
 bgp router-id 10.255.255.1
 neighbor 192.0.2.1 remote-as 64500
 neighbor 192.0.2.1 description TRANSIT-A
 !
 address-family ipv4 unicast
  neighbor 192.0.2.1 maximum-prefix 10000 80
  neighbor 192.0.2.1 route-map TRANSIT-A-IN in
 exit-address-family
!
route-map TRANSIT-A-IN permit 10
 match ip address prefix-list CUSTOMER-ROUTES
!

golden.pe-01:
hostname pe-01
!
router bgp 65000
 bgp router-id 10.255.255.1
 neighbor 192.0.2.1 remote-as 64500
 neighbor 192.0.2.1 description TRANSIT-A
 !
 address-family ipv4 unicast
  neighbor 192.0.2.1 maximum-prefix 10000 80 restart 30
  neighbor 192.0.2.1 route-map TRANSIT-A-IN in
 exit-address-family
!
route-map TRANSIT-A-IN permit 10
 match ip address prefix-list CUSTOMER-ROUTES
 match rpki valid
!
